the first stars formed out of primordial gas in a manner similar to present star formation, except that the characteristic mass of the first stars was much greater than that of present stars, and the first stars were formed in a more massive and more diffuse environment than present stars.

there is an intrinsic mass and radius scale for galaxy formation, with a mass scale approximately 10/sup -3/M/sup 2/ and radius scale M/sup 1/4/.
